FOOT' and give the trade; they do not say where this household lived, who else was in it, or when it came. So the record around this person carries nothing but the person: no dwelling, no division, no family, each written as unattested in its own block rather than filled in from the shape of the rest of the town. Cited at the Democrat of 26 November 1833, column 16; the Democrat of 4 March 1834, column 25. THE TOWN NEVER INVENTED A ROOF FOR THIS TRADE.
